independent_oracle.interpretation: Variance reduction follows conditioning on empirical per-aliquot proportions instead of pooled proportions, not improved accuracy. Taxon-zero aliquots can give degenerate plug-in counting covariance and understate finite-sample uncertainty. No interval coverage or chronology-distribution claim.

count_model.primitive: One immutable (collection_unit_id,dataset_id,native_sample_id) observation per selected source sample; aliases/count or digest clashes refuse. Native analysis-unit IDs also retained privately, not substituted for sample identity.
count_model.axis: Exactly the common measured literal Betula/Poaceae panel, in this order, for every primitive and output; fixed N_i=n_i,Betula+n_i,Poaceae. Other NISP is excluded and separately retained, never inserted into the multinomial denominator.
count_model.covariance: C_i=diag(n_i)-outer(n_i,n_i)/N_i; plugin conditional multinomial with integer measured counts, positive panel total; count sources never independently renormalized per profile.
count_model.independence: Distinct counted native samples are conditionally independent counting observations, including samples in one core. This does not assert ecological, environmental, sediment or temporal independence. Same sample in different profiles/windows is the same primitive observation.
count_model.selection: All membership fixed conditional on the two native point chronology selections. Different chronology profiles are not independent replicate sites.
count_model.no_imputation: Missing/unmeasured axis, ambiguous literal mapping, negative/fractional/bool counts, zero total and absent source windows refuse; explicit measured taxon zero remains permitted.

ppe_model.source: Exact original source protocol/public-profile input magnitudes retained. Diagonal taxon covariance and one global two-axis shared PPE vector across all cores, windows and chronologies are declared working assumptions, not an estimated cross-core PPE covariance.
ppe_model.count_independence: Counts and PPE have zero cross-covariance conditional on this scenario; unsupported correlated/endogenous PPE is outside scope.

age_selection.source_epoch: AD1950 documented Neotoma convention, not article date
age_selection.membership: Reuse exact maintained select() and its finite typed named-age/source-window equality guards; half-open bins from original protocol; retain missing/ambiguous/outside/allzero/refused tokens.
age_selection.bounds: No source interval distribution or probability inferred; alternate point profiles are deterministic selections.

physical_model.binding: Read exact factors from both saved profiles at every occupied window and require parity with pair-specific source facts above; factor, radius candidate, PPE and literal axes hashed. No quadrature or new geometry or wind.
physical_model.scope: Static radius candidates remain unauthenticated historical geometry; source site/core handles and rights restrictions unchanged.

interpretation_limits: This is a new first-order fixed-support counting/PPE covariance scenario, not chronology posterior propagation or calibrated interval coverage.
No independent chronology accuracy, environmental independence, biological whole-vegetation accuracy, historical LandClim reproduction, source licensing/review, or untouched validation admitted.
Original deterministic point contrasts and all missing/refused populations remain authoritative for their original scope; original pooled marginal SEs remain untouched.
Current uncertainty describes conditional local delta approximation and retains all poor/unchanged effects, exact zeros and failures.

Empirical per-aliquot taxon zero may yield degenerate plug-in count variance and understate finite-sample uncertainty. Report one-taxon-only primitives and exact-zero marginals/contrasts explicitly; variance reduction is changed conditioning, not measured precision gain.
